summary: A licensed card game riff on the classic 4X video game, where players expand an empire, tech up, and clash militarily using action-point card play. It plays as a fairly light, quick skirmish game rather than a deep space-empire simulation.
praised: quick, accessible take on a beloved video game IP
asymmetric race powers give some replay variety
criticised: doesn't capture the depth or scale fans expected from the video game
take-that attacks can feel random and frustrating
combat swinginess can overshadow strategic planning
seen as a fairly generic 4X-lite card game

scoring.why: victory points come from a mix of territory, technology, and military conquest

_name: Master of Orion: The Board Game
